text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—I mean, come on. For someone like me, 
haven't I done pretty well up until now?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I ran the Satsuki Sho. My hoof healed up. 
I put up solid results in GⅡs and all 
that. Seriously, I did more than great, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So the only version of me that needs to 
stay in everyone's minds is the one from 
last year.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: From here on out—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Don't look at me when I'm being so 
uncool.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Mom's car is here! Let's all go to the 
beach today!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ayyy~â Afterparty, afterparty~â

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"...Jordan? U good? Wait, are you skipping 
training again today?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, yep! I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
They told me to rest my legs for a while 
anyway. ...So I guess there's no need to 
contact Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
Oho, what're you doing on your phone? 
Texting your crush on LANE~?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
...! That's not it at all. Jeez! Come on, 
let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The New Year's holiday has ended, and 
classes have resumed for a few days now. 
Still, there has been no word from Tosen 
Jordan.
choice_data_list: (It shows as read, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether messaging her on the LANE app or 
going all the way to her classroom, she 
keeps running away, making it impossible 
to get in touch with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle...)
choice_data_list: Could it be...!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Jordan's Trainer, do you have a 
moment to talk?
choice_data_list: ...Did you want to talk?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I received this message from a 
student in my class...

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Youth, you stupid jerk~~~! I lost the 
debut race again~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, my feet are freezing! The winter sea 
is brutal, straight-up next level☆

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (...Ah, that's nice. The ocean, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(If I dip my feet in now, will my nail 
polish peel off? I didn't bring my 
moisturizing oil, either.)

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: "...Jordan? You goin' into the ocean too?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah. But if you stop caring about 
stuff like your nails too...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —I guess I don't need to worry anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: ...? Jordan...?
choice_data_list: Wait!!
Wait!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...!? Why is Trainer here...?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
...Gh, sorry, Jordan! I was just worried 
about how you've been acting lately—

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"Sensei, help!! Do you know Jordan's 
Trainer's contact info?!"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"Jordan's been completely down in the 
dumps. Nothing we do seems to cheer her 
up. We're heading to the beach right now, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, why...? Going as far as to contact 
the teacher about that..."
choice_data_list:
They must have been that worried about 
you.
I was just that worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're totally exaggerating! We're just 
the kind of friends who goof off together 
in the heat of the moment, after all...
choice_data_list:
Do you really think that's all our 
relationship is?

Do you really think that's all our 
relationship is?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait, what's going on!? Also, 
why are you here, Trainer!? And why are 
you mad!?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, no way! You worked so hard last 
year, Jordan, didn't you?! So I really 
want you to have fun at least for today!!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Jordan's like our shining star, so 
we want her to give it her all! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, she's like... a shining star 
among gals...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Looks like everyone looked up to you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Looks like everyone looked up to you."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, but... I'm not the kind of 
Umamusume anyone would look up to, you 
know...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There're plenty of other gal superstars 
out there! Like City, Helios, Palmer! 
They're way more amazing than me, y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, I'm an idiot! It's 
impossible! There's no way I can compete 
in the Senior division!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna lose, lose, and lose big 
time! I mean, you don't even belong on the 
same track to challenge them!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You'll run a garbage race and end up with 
totally lame results...!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: ...Still, we're fools too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I just can't help admiring Jordan. After 
all, she was the first one who gave me 
such a seriously awesome dream.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how many times you lose. I just 
know you'll always show us how cool you 
are, Jordan."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: ...Right, you're an idiot!
...Right, you are an idiot!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaah...?
choice_data_list: What a total idiot!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Armed only with the vague, floating goal 
of "wanting to make it big," she 
fearlessly took on the Triple Crown 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even though her career as an athlete was 
on the line in the Satsuki Sho, driven 
purely by the desire to run, she fought to 
overcome even her injuries."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
'Sup~. I made 5 nail tips. Pretty 
impressive, right? Aren't I great?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, 15 seconds! I'm gonna do it! Time 
me, okay!? Ready... set...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Even without fully understanding it, you 
faced your training with utter 
earnestness.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I kept challenging myself with everything 
I had. I worked insanely hard like a fool.
choice_data_list: That's why I was able to grow stronger.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "...What's that... even supposed to..."
choice_data_list: That's why I've always kept fighting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter what hardships stood in my way, 
I've always fought through them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Tosen Jordan had been a sensible girl, 
she would have set steady goals and 
withdrawn from the Satsuki Sho the moment 
something went wrong with her hooves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the lineup for the Arima Kinen, 
I might have even considered withdrawing 
my entry myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to "common sense," you must have 
understood what was impossible and 
considered giving up every time you hit a 
wall.
choice_data_list:
But you're a fool who always tried to take 
on the challenge

But you're a fool who always tried to take 
on the challenge

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter what others said, no matter how 
tough the wall in front of me was, I kept 
challenging it carefree, thinking, 'Maybe 
I can overcome it.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And indeed—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, we've managed to work things out so 
far, right? In that case, don't we just 
gotta give it our all?
choice_data_list:
Watching you take on the challenge was so 
cool.

Watching you take on the challenge was 
truly inspiring.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Don't say 'jordan' (joke) like that.
choice_data_list: No, you really did look so cool!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan's friends also nodded in 
agreement.
choice_data_list:
So let's try letting loose and acting 
foolish!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the wall known as common sense ever 
blocks your path again, just cast aside 
reason and challenge it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because she is an Umamusume who has 
surpassed all of that before."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... As if...
choice_data_list:
Still, wouldn't being the "greatest idiot" 
be pretty cool?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ............ ...Are you an idiot?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... You are such an idiot! Idiot, 
idiot, idiot, iiiidiooot!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"'The strongest idiot,' really...? I've 
never heard of such a thing. That's 
just... ngh."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Only an idiot like me could ever pull 
it off...!"
choice_data_list: That's right!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Sh-Shut up... idiot...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Tosen Jordan finally let the tears welled 
up in the corners of her eyes spill over.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Soy sauce noodles, broth, toppings!! Bring 
all three together--

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Extra olive oil!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...And you're telling me to aim for THAT? 
You've gotta be kidding, right?"
choice_data_list:
If she's the strongest, I guess she's just 
another wall to overcome...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Man, oh man... That was seriously 
not cool. Ahh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, Gold Ship has announced her entry 
into the Senior Spring Triple Crown, 
including the Osaka Hai— she's a 
powerhouse. And an unconventional 
Umamusume at that—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm seri~~ously being super dumb, but... 
Do I really have to do it? That... "Osaka 
Hai", was it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, first up is the Osaka Hai
Yeah, first, at the Osaka Hai,

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Extra drizzle of olive oil.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Jordan! Welcome back! Are you in the 
middle of training?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: !? Palmer!? Umm...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Found a goal? If you're going to run, 
I'll join you."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. Can I ask you for that favor 
later then?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—From now on, I'm aiming to be the 
strongest!
